title: At least 31 killed as fuel tanker crash ignites large fire on Cairo highway
summary_full: Blaze on ring road surrounding Egyptian capital injures at least 21 people and leaves cars and motorcycles charredA crash involving a fuel tanker ignited a huge fire on a highway surrounding Cairo on Wednesday, killing at least 31 people, Egyptian authorities said.The blaze on the ring road, a key artery that encircles the Egyptian capital, also injured at least 21 people and left more than two dozen cars and motorcycles charred, according to the latest figures released by the health ministry.
